title: Approvals
description: Commands the user has approved, stored apart from the settings files so no settings write can erase or change them. One file per scope: ~/.maiestro/approvals/<owner>-<name>.json for one repo, ~/.maiestro/approvals/global.json for all repos. mAIestro Code only ever adds entries; revoke an approval by editing or deleting the file. This schema is the hand-written specification for the file format; the Rust Approvals struct must conform to it (a unit test enforces the two stay in sync). Unknown fields are tolerated so files written by a newer app version still load in an older one.

post_spawn_commands.description: Post-spawn commands approved to run without asking, matched by their exact (trimmed) text. A spawn asks first unless every one of the repo's post_spawn_commands is approved here or in the other scope's file.
